data.desc: The Kemper family of companies is one of the nation's leading specialized insurers. With approximately $12 billion in assets, Kemper is improving the world of insurance by providing affordable and easy-to-use personalized solutions to individuals, families and businesses through its Kemper Auto and Kemper Life brands. Kemper serves approximately 4.3 million policies, is represented by approximately 24,000 agents and brokers, and has approximately 6,700 associates dedicated to meeting the ever-changing needs of its customers.
